description:
Use this when the user is looking for a job, or for hiring signals, among postings from the last 30 days.

Filters: naics (up to 10 codes), state, keyword (title only), posted_within_days (posted within the last 1 to 30 days, default 30), limit (1 to 50, default 20). Rows carry title, agency (the employer), state, city, posted_at and url. If has_more is true, call again with cursor=next_cursor and the same filters. Example: keyword="electrician", state="TX". Pass several NAICS codes in one call.

Print each result's url as a markdown link.

Do not use for contracts (search_contracts) or grants (search_grants).

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous response. Pass it with the same filters to get the next page.
cursor.title: Cursor

keyword.description: 2 to 100 characters matched against the title only.
keyword.title: Keyword

limit.description: Number of results to return, 1 to 50.
limit.title: Limit

naics.description: Up to 10 six-digit NAICS codes, comma-separated, e.g. '236220' or '541511,541512'. A record matches on its own codes (matched_naics says which). Unknown codes are ignored.
naics.title: Naics

posted_within_days.description: Only jobs posted within the last N days, 1 to 30 (default 30).
posted_within_days.title: Posted Within Days

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. 'VA'. Many federal notices have no state, so this filter skips them.
state.title: State

name: search_jobs

OpportunityRow.description: One search result. Jobs fill title, agency (the employer), state, city, posted_at and url only.

ai_matched_naics.description: Only when you filtered by naics: requested codes this contract notice matched only because MatchAwards' AI suggested them, not its own codes. Call such a match AI-suggested.
ai_matched_naics.title: Ai Matched Naics

id.description: Pass to get_opportunity for the description and contacts.
id.title: Id

matched_naics.description: Only when you filtered by naics: the requested codes this record carries: its own code (in naics) or, for a grant or job, another code of its program or occupation.
matched_naics.title: Matched Naics

naics.description: On state notices (type state) the naics code itself is AI-assigned.

no_fixed_deadline.description: true: the deadline is a placeholder date.
no_fixed_deadline.title: No Fixed Deadline

sam_url.description: The SAM.gov notice (federal only). Show it as a markdown link.
sam_url.title: Sam Url

url.description: The posting on matchawards.com. Show it as a markdown link.
url.title: Url

OpportunityRow.title: OpportunityRow

as_of.description: When the API generated the results (ISO time).
as_of.title: As Of

has_more.description: true: call again with cursor=next_cursor and the same filters.
has_more.title: Has More

warning.description: Set when paging stopped early; the results so far are still valid.
warning.title: Warning

title: Search jobs
